scientific_scope_status: A fresh independent dual-rail flag |0_F>=|01>,|1_F>=|10>, prepared/accepted in plus, implements each complete system/bath Kraus branch(K_l+T K_l T)/2 for a specified involution T=Tdagger,T²=I, with minus branch(K_l-T K_l T)/2. Collective flag dephasing(Z_f+Z_g)B(t) annihilates the code even during code-preserving finite controls; it does not cancel arbitrary target/bath gate errors. For a block-diagonal reference, in-code perturbation D and offblock V with d=integral||D|| and l=integral||QVP||, accepted amplitude error<=d+l²/2 and flag-leakage amplitude<=l, independent of Q-block energy. A joint full-Stinespring error bound gives a previously forbidden unnormalized completed-task effect<=(d+l²/2)² I, quartic only for pure leakage. Three collective-SU2 flag spins supply a logical/gauge subsystem, but its protected target control lies outside the declared single-flag-spin/target Pauli coupling span.

validation.internal: Completed source-exposed intake-author mathematical reconstruction of the actual191-line proof. Derived the sandwich by two logical path blocks for arbitrary full-memory Kraus operators, both outcomes and code erasures; checked code annihilation and encoded preparation/readout generators. Reconstructed the exact offblock Duhamel integral, leakage amplitude and triangle-integral l²/2 bound with arbitrary diagonal Q dynamics, then separated the in-code D allowance. Used the normalized Bell isometry and orthogonal Pauli components to derive the forbidden unnormalized effect from ONE joint Stinespring budget, retaining the required completed-task boundary. Reconstructed the in-code phase false-acceptance witness and why small unconditional effect supplies no conditional guarantee. For SU2, the one-body flag coefficient vectors have no scalar invariant; the independent target Pauli factors force all27 cross coefficients to vanish. Verified the algebraic singlet-controlled involution and separated it from a synthesized native gate. Exact rational finite matrices and sparse Pauli commutators are curator regression checks, not the unacquired producer programs, reported numerical tables, a primary-paper priority audit or hardware validation. Actual prior U1023 governing coarse-instrument passage was read; its trusted framing/record/terminal conditions remain unchanged.
